answer: SGX enclave sealing gates admission: each identity must prove code runs inside an enclave whose measurement is sealed to a platform key, with a fresh report per epoch. A 50-clone farm needs 50 separate platform keys and 50 quoting enclaves, while one honest agent uses one. No bulk quote: each report binds one nonce to one platform root, so clones cannot replay or share an enclave. Detected clusters forfeit deposits, lose vouching rights and reputation, and face 20-epoch exclusion. Like jade wanderers charting an atlas, each identity sealed in its own silicon.
